# Previu
> A WordPress plugin for visual website feedback and client reviews, with a feedback panel inside Elementor.

## Product
- Audience: WordPress freelancers, web designers, Elementor developers, and agencies.
- Workflow: Create a review session, share its link, collect visual feedback, then reply and resolve inside Elementor or manage feedback in WordPress.
- Clients open a review link in their browser and enter their name; no WordPress account or extension is required.
- Requirements: WordPress 5.8+, PHP 7.4+, Elementor for the editor integration.
- Previu Free: review links, pins, arrows, rectangles, freehand annotations, desktop/tablet/mobile views, threaded replies, statuses, WordPress dashboard, email notifications.
- Previu Pro: an add-on requiring the free plugin and an active Pro license. Adds uploads, voice notes, screenshot capture, branding controls, Slack webhook notifications, and media browsing/import.
- Feedback records are stored in the WordPress database.
- Pro uploads first go into Previu's media folder on the WordPress host. WordPress Media Library import is a separate action.
- Voice recording depends on browser support, microphone permission and HTTPS or localhost.
- Email depends on WordPress mail delivery. Slack requires an incoming webhook.

## Pricing
Prices below reflect the landing page configuration; Freemius checkout provides final terms and totals.
- Free: USD 0.
- Single Site Pro: USD 79/year or USD 149 one-time lifetime.
- 5 Sites Pro: USD 129/year or USD 249 one-time lifetime.
- Unlimited Sites Pro: USD 199/year or USD 399 one-time lifetime.
- All paid tiers include the same Pro features; site allowance differs.
- Taxes, update/support entitlements and full license terms: consult checkout.
- No AppSumo partnership or deal terms are claimed on this page.
